verdict.rationale: Groq's evidence documents an LLM inference API (chat completions, Responses API, tool use, structured outputs) that developers could use to build insight features. There is no documented in-product feature that analyzes the user's own data, such as usage or billing, and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions. These are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
